what: The recorded AI dashboard design for the site's sample ledger (engine/sample-messy.csv), applied by engine/nl_dashboard.py only when the file is that sample byte for byte, so the demo's Dashboard tab appears with no AI call. A run with the AI on designs the dashboard again. Every element is checked by the engine like a live design; the engine computes every figure.
recorded: A recorded AI design: written once by the AI planner for this sample (16 Oct 2026) and replayed, so this demo needs no AI call. Run your own file with the AI on for a live design.

dashboard.audience: A property manager checking rent and repair spending across the portfolio

questions.q: How much rent is charged each month, and is it growing?
Which kinds of repair and service cost the most, and is that rising?
Which properties carry the most repair and service spending?
Has rent at each property grown on the year before?
How many ledger lines are still unpaid?

charts.title: Rent charged by month
charts.why: Shows whether rent is growing month by month and where it stepped up

charts.title: Repair and service spending by kind: the latest year against the year before
charts.why: Ranks the kinds of work by cost and shows which grew

charts.title: Repair and service spending by property
charts.why: Ranks the properties by what their upkeep costs

charts.title: Rent by property: the latest year against the year before
charts.why: Separates growth at the properties held throughout from new properties
